markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (83%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
Invasive probability is 2%, but the model cannot separate Benign from InSitu. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 83%, InSitu 11%, Normal 4%, Invasive 2% | Clear lead, low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign | Weak support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Score well below typical; concept model lowers invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score, consistent with benign tissue · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score; small effect · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; relevant to in situ question [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier; mitotic figures [F3] are unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Image is a simulated degraded resample (severity 3); reliability score only moderately predicts errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Only 2 of 5 similar cases are Benign; an in situ lesion may be missed.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6** — look for atypical cells confined within ducts; concept only weakly validated.
2. **Region 0** — confirm absence of infiltrating stroma; score is below typical here.
3. **Regions 1, 7** — confirm gland architecture and benign stroma or normal lobules.
